description: Next generation frontend tooling. It's fast!
summary: I found 53 PRs merged in the past 90 days within 100 recently updated closed PRs. @sapphi-red authored 16 of those merges. I inspected 10 selected PRs for diff and inline-review counts. These awards describe the observed snapshot, not developer skill or the project's contribution policy.

awards.name: Merge Machine
awards.headline: @sapphi-red
awards.description: Authored the most merges in this snapshot.
awards.scope: 53 observed merges in the past 90 days, from 100 recently updated closed PRs.

awards.name: Delete Club
awards.headline: @sapphi-red
awards.description: PR #23661 deleted the most lines among inspected PRs. It also added 289 lines.
awards.scope: 10 of 10 selected recent merged PRs inspected. Counts include all file types.

awards.name: Comment Magnet
awards.headline: PR #23655
awards.description: The busiest inline review conversation among inspected PRs. A comment count is not a roast or a defect count.
awards.scope: 10 of 10 selected recent merged PRs inspected. Counts include all file types.

awards.name: The Cast
awards.headline: Meet the cast
awards.description: Distinct accounts that authored merged PRs in this snapshot. Includes bot accounts; this is not a count of new or external contributors.
awards.scope: 53 observed merges in the past 90 days, from 100 recently updated closed PRs.

awards.name: The Long Goodbye
awards.headline: PR #6267
awards.description: The oldest open PR returned by GitHub's oldest-first listing. Age does not mean neglect.
awards.scope: 30 oldest open PRs read. This is calendar age, not time waiting for review.

evidence.title: feat: allow assets to be external instead of inline in lib mode.

awards.name: Fastest Lap
awards.headline: PR #23657
awards.description: Shortest PR opening-to-merge time observed. Includes draft time, waiting and automation. This is not time spent coding.
awards.scope: 53 observed merges in the past 90 days, from 100 recently updated closed PRs.

notes: The closed-PR scan stopped at one page. Merge awards describe this snapshot, not every merge in the period.
